decision: Use platform-available memory with a 4 GiB or 10 percent reserve
why: Native hxhx/Reflaxe peaks are roughly 1.6-3.5 GiB, while macOS raw free pages understate reclaimable memory by two orders of magnitude; a maximum of 4 GiB and 10 percent protects a native build without copying the 7.2 GiB legacy-wrapper maximum into every host.
evidence: bd:haxe_ocaml-850ii.15 comments; memory_pressure -Q=42 percent; os.freemem about 115 MiB on the same 32 GiB host
result: Prefer macOS memory_pressure and Linux MemAvailable, use Windows OS free memory, report but do not enforce untrusted fallback data, and keep thresholds explicitly overridable for measurement.
